obs: "A number of the remarks quoted as having been made in relation to Negroes access to privately owned accommodations in fact dealt with other questions altogether. ... It is implied that such remarks cast light on the question of access to privately owned accommodations. In fact, the statement, made in the course of a debate on a bill (S. 60) to enlarge the powers of the Freedmens Bureau, related solely to Black Laws that had been enacted in some of the Southern States."
